method: seven-agent fan-out: five truth domains plus the consistency and completeness auditors; note here how it was run so a reader can judge the coverage
_contract: All five domains must appear and no others. Copy every block below even when a domain
found nothing -- an absent domain is a gap nobody can see, which is exactly what a skipped
pass looks like.
claims_checked is the number of individual assertions that domain examined and must be > 0.
Without it, 'no findings' cannot be told apart from 'nobody ran this'.
plan binds the report to one itinerary; the checker compares it to the file it is given, so
one clean report cannot certify every trip.
verdict: confirmed | wrong | misleading | unverifiable. Only report the last three --
confirmed claims are noise. severity: critical | major | minor.
resolved is required on wrong and misleading, and resolution names the change that fixed it.
No code can prove a resolution actually happened, so write it for a human to check by eye.
audits is a required sibling of domains, and carries exactly two entries: consistency and
completeness. Their findings use the same shape, the same verdict and severity enums, and the
same rule -- resolved is required on wrong and misleading. They differ from a domain only in
needing no network: consistency re-decides what check_plan_consistency.py decides plus what a
script cannot express, such as whether a day's pacing is physically possible; completeness asks
what is missing -- which stated preference is served only by a token anchor, which hard
constraint is asserted but never measured, which collected field never reaches the page.
They are here because references/verification.md has always told the operator to run seven
agents while this schema accepted five, so a report that followed the reference failed the gate
and the cheapest way out was to delete the two auditors. In the measured run those two produced
27 of 55 findings and 5 of the 6 criticals -- the deletion the schema was rewarding would have
thrown away most of the verification.
Delete this _contract key before saving the real report.

findings.claim: the plan's own words, quoted, so a reader can find what was wrong
findings.correction: what is actually true, stated concretely
findings.resolution: which field of the plan changed, and how
